title: Restricting a list segment
statement: Let $\mu:\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$, and suppose a list $l$ of length $N$ records the values of $\mu$ on the consecutive indices starting at $a$, with $a+N\le\mathrm{top}$. For natural numbers $k,n$ with $k+n\le N$, the list obtained by dropping the first $k$ entries of $l$ and taking the next $n$ entries has length $n$, records $\mu$ starting at $a+k$, and satisfies $a+k+n\le\mathrm{top}$.
hypotheses_covered: l records μ on the segment starting at a
